big_picture_notes: The Hebrew title Devarim ('Words') accurately describes the book's content as a series of formal orations. It is fundamentally a valedictory (farewell) speech—a series of three final addresses by Moses on the plains of Moab before his death. The book's genre is inherently persuasive, blending historical review, legal exposition, and prophetic warning. Its literary genius lies in using the Ancient Near Eastern suzerain-vassal treaty as the chassis for theological message. Deuteronomy is a covenant renewal document casting YHWH as the Great King (Suzerain) who benevolently rescued Israel (vassal) from Egypt. The rhetoric is sermonic and hortatory throughout, aiming to transform hearts, not merely secure compliance. The entire structure maps directly onto classical ANE treaty form: Preamble, Historical Prologue, General Stipulations, Specific Stipulations, Sanctions, Covenant Renewal, Deposition & Succession, Witnesses, and Epilogue.

stories.story_title: The First Address: History as Hortatory
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Moses' first speech: a sermonic retelling of the wilderness journey from Horeb to Moab, turning history into exhortation. Ends with the cities of refuge east of the Jordan (4:41-43), the narrative bridge before the second address.

scenes.scene_name: The Superscription and Setting
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'These are the words Moses spoke.' Ends with Moses beginning to expound the law. Devices: Geographic frame; 'beyond the Jordan' sets the vantage point of the whole book.

scenes.scene_name: The Command from Horeb
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'You have stayed long enough at this mountain.' Ends 'go in and take possession.' Devices: The land-promise to the patriarchs invoked as warrant.

scenes.scene_name: Moses Cannot Bear the People Alone
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with Moses' burden. Ends 'how can I bear your problems alone?' Devices: The growth-as-blessing motif strains leadership.

scenes.scene_name: Wise Leaders Appointed Over the Tribes
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'choose wise men.' Ends with commanders set over thousands. Devices: Shared governance recalled from Exodus 18.

scenes.scene_name: Judge Righteously, Great and Small Alike
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the charge to the judges. Ends 'the judgment is God's.' Devices: Impartial justice; 'do not be afraid of any man.'

scenes.scene_name: Go Up and Take the Land
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the journey to Kadesh-barnea. Ends 'do not be afraid.' Devices: The land set before them; the first call to faith.

scenes.scene_name: The Spies Sent; the Good Report
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the people's request to scout. Ends 'it is a good land.' Devices: Even the spies confirm the gift before the failure.

scenes.scene_name: The People Refuse to Go Up
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you were unwilling.' Ends with hearts melting over the Anakim. Devices: Grumbling in the tents; fear distorts the report.

scenes.scene_name: 'The LORD Will Fight for You'—Yet They Would Not Trust
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses' reassurance. Ends 'you did not trust the LORD.' Devices: The pillar of fire and cloud cited as proof of God's care.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD's Oath: None but Caleb Will Enter
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the LORD's anger. Ends with Caleb's reward. Devices: The oath of exclusion; faith rewarded with inheritance.

scenes.scene_name: Even Moses Barred; Turn Back
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'because of you the LORD was angry with me.' Ends with the turn to the wilderness. Devices: Moses implicated; the children will inherit instead.

scenes.scene_name: The Presumptuous Defeat at Hormah
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with belated, presumptuous zeal. Ends with weeping at Kadesh. Devices: Disobedient attack 'without the LORD'—routed like bees.

scenes.scene_name: Long Years Around Mount Seir
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with years skirting the hill country. Ends 'turn north.' Devices: The wandering summarized; God's timing governs the march.

scenes.scene_name: Pass by Edom Peaceably
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the command regarding Esau's descendants. Ends 'you have lacked nothing.' Devices: Restraint toward kin; provision in the desert.

scenes.scene_name: Past Moab; the Land of Ar
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts skirting Moab. Ends with a note on the Horites. Devices: Antiquarian asides; Moab's land not for Israel (Lot's sons).

scenes.scene_name: Crossing the Zered; a Generation Gone
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts at the Zered Valley. Ends 'until the whole generation had perished.' Devices: The thirty-eight years closed; the death sentence fulfilled.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Harass Moab or Ammon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts after the warriors died off. Ends with Ammon as Lot's sons. Devices: Boundaries of conquest divinely fixed.

scenes.scene_name: Ancient Peoples of the Land Recalled
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the Rephaim and Zamzummim. Ends with the Caphtorim. Devices: Learned digression—God has displaced nations before.

scenes.scene_name: Rise Up: the Dread of Israel Begins
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'set out and cross the Arnon.' Ends with dread upon the nations. Devices: The turn from wandering to conquest; fear precedes Israel.

scenes.scene_name: Sihon Refuses Passage; His Heart Hardened
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the peaceful offer to Sihon. Ends 'the LORD hardened his spirit.' Devices: Refusal becomes the occasion of conquest (cf. Pharaoh).

scenes.scene_name: Sihon Defeated at Jahaz
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'I have begun to give Sihon over.' Ends with his defeat. Devices: The first conquest east of the Jordan.

scenes.scene_name: The Cities Devoted to Destruction
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the ban on Sihon's cities. Ends with restraint toward Ammon's border. Devices: Herem warfare bounded by divine limits.

scenes.scene_name: Og of Bashan Defeated
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with Og marching out. Ends with sixty fortified cities taken. Devices: A second giant-king felled; momentum builds.

scenes.scene_name: Sixty Cities Taken; Og's Iron Bed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the devotion of Bashan. Ends with Og's iron bedstead. Devices: Antiquarian proof of the last of the Rephaim.

scenes.scene_name: Land Given to Reuben, Gad, Half-Manasseh
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts dividing the conquered land. Ends with the Jordan boundary. Devices: The Transjordan settlement recorded.

scenes.scene_name: The Armed Men Must Cross First; 'Do Not Fear'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the charge to the eastern tribes. Ends 'the LORD your God will fight for you.' Devices: Solidarity in conquest; Joshua encouraged.

scenes.scene_name: 'Let Me Cross Over'—the LORD Refuses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses' plea to see the land. Ends 'do not speak to me again of this.' Devices: Poignant denial; 'the LORD was angry with me because of you.'

scenes.scene_name: View the Land from Pisgah; Commission Joshua
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'go up to Pisgah.' Ends in the valley near Beth-peor. Devices: Sight without entry; Joshua charged.

scenes.scene_name: Hear and Obey; Add Nothing, Take Nothing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the great exhortation. Ends with those who held fast 'alive today.' Devices: The canon-principle; Baal-peor as cautionary memory.

scenes.scene_name: Your Wisdom Before the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'see, I have taught you.' Ends 'what great nation has such righteous laws?' Devices: Obedience as witness to the watching nations.

scenes.scene_name: The Warning from Horeb's Experience
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'watch yourselves closely.' Ends with the two tablets. Devices: Memory and teaching to children; 'you heard words but saw no form.'

scenes.scene_name: You Saw No Form—Make No Idol
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you saw no form.' Ends 'his own inheritance.' Devices: The aniconic argument; idolatry as betrayal.

scenes.scene_name: A Consuming Fire, a Jealous God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts recalling Moses' exclusion. Ends 'a consuming fire, a jealous God.' Devices: Covenant jealousy; the danger of forgetting.

scenes.scene_name: Corruption Will Bring Exile
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you have children.' Ends serving lifeless idols. Devices: Prophetic foresight of exile—the curse named early.

scenes.scene_name: Seek Him and He Will Be Found
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'but if you seek the LORD.' Ends 'he will not forget the covenant.' Devices: Mercy beyond judgment; the door of return.

scenes.scene_name: Has Any God Done Such Things?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'ask now about former days.' Ends 'the LORD is God; there is no other.' Devices: The argument from unique history—Sinai and the exodus.

scenes.scene_name: Know Today: the LORD Is God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the voice from heaven. Ends 'that it may go well with you.' Devices: Election, redemption, and obedience bound together.

scenes.scene_name: Cities of Refuge East of the Jordan
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'then Moses set apart three cities.' Ends naming Bezer, Ramoth, Golan. Devices: A narrative interlude closing the first address; mercy embedded in law.

stories.story_title: The Second Address, Part 1: The Heart of the Covenant
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: The exhortatory core: the Decalogue (ch 5), the Shema (6:4-9), and the great call to love and remember (7-11). Begins with the law's superscription (4:44-49) and ends at the blessing-and-curse on Gerizim and Ebal (11:26-32).

scenes.scene_name: Preamble to the Second Speech
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'this is the law Moses set before Israel.' Ends with the conquered territory. Devices: Formal heading reintroducing the law-giving.

scenes.scene_name: The Horeb Covenant with This Generation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'Hear, O Israel.' Ends 'I stood between the LORD and you.' Devices: 'Not with our fathers but with us'—the covenant made present.

scenes.scene_name: No Other Gods; No Idols
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'I am the LORD your God.' Ends 'showing love to a thousand generations.' Devices: The first commandments; grounded in the exodus.

scenes.scene_name: The Name; the Sabbath (Remember Egypt)
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the Name. Ends 'remember you were slaves in Egypt.' Devices: Deuteronomy's redemptive (not creation) Sabbath rationale.

scenes.scene_name: Honor Parents; Love of Neighbor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'honor your father and mother.' Ends 'you shall not covet.' Devices: The second-table commands; from act to desire.

scenes.scene_name: The People Beg Moses to Mediate
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the voice from the fire. Ends 'you go near and listen.' Devices: Terror at the divine voice; mediation requested.

scenes.scene_name: 'Oh That They Had Such a Heart'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the LORD's approval of their words. Ends 'walk in all the way I command.' Devices: The longing for an obedient heart—answered later (30:6).

scenes.scene_name: The Purpose of the Law: Life in the Land
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'these are the commands.' Ends 'a land flowing with milk and honey.' Devices: Obedience tied to long life and blessing.

scenes.scene_name: The Shema: the Great Commandment
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'Hear, O Israel: the LORD our God, the LORD is one.' Ends with words on doorframes and gates. Devices: The center of Deuteronomy—total love; teach, bind, write.

scenes.scene_name: When You Are Full, Do Not Forget
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the gift of a ready-built land. Ends 'a jealous God.' Devices: Prosperity as a spiritual danger; the warning against forgetting.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Test the LORD; Do What Is Right
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not test the LORD as at Massah.' Ends driving out the enemies. Devices: Massah recalled; obedience as the path to the promise.

scenes.scene_name: When Your Son Asks: Tell the Story
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the child's question. Ends 'it will be our righteousness.' Devices: Catechesis—the exodus rehearsed for the next generation.

scenes.scene_name: Devote the Nations; Make No Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the seven nations. Ends 'burn their idols.' Devices: Separation from idolatry; no intermarriage.

scenes.scene_name: A People Holy and Chosen in Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you are a holy people.' Ends 'he redeemed you from slavery.' Devices: Election by love, not merit—'the fewest of all peoples.'

scenes.scene_name: The Faithful God Who Keeps Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'know therefore.' Ends 'follow them.' Devices: The covenant-keeping God who repays both love and hatred.

scenes.scene_name: Blessings for Obedience: Fruitfulness and Health
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you pay attention.' Ends consuming the nations. Devices: Fertility, health, victory promised; no disease of Egypt.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Fear Them; Remember Egypt
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you may say, these nations are stronger.' Ends 'a great and awesome God.' Devices: Memory of Egypt as the antidote to fear.

scenes.scene_name: Little by Little; Destroy Their Idols
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'little by little.' Ends 'utterly detest it.' Devices: Gradual conquest; idols as devoted things to be destroyed.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Humbled and Tested You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'be careful to follow.' Ends 'as a man disciplines his son.' Devices: Manna as a lesson—'man does not live on bread alone.'

scenes.scene_name: A Good Land You Are Entering
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the call to obedience. Ends 'a land where you will lack nothing.' Devices: Lavish description of the land's goodness.

scenes.scene_name: When You Are Full, Bless Him—Do Not Forget
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you have eaten and are satisfied.' Ends 'your heart will become proud.' Devices: The danger of self-sufficiency.

scenes.scene_name: Remember Who Gave You Power to Prosper
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts recalling the wilderness. Ends 'he gives you the ability to produce wealth.' Devices: Prosperity traced back to God, not self.

scenes.scene_name: Forget Him and You Will Perish
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you ever forget.' Ends 'you will perish.' Devices: The stark alternative closes the chapter.

scenes.scene_name: Cross Over Today; the LORD Goes Before You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'Hear, O Israel: you are crossing.' Ends 'subdue them quickly.' Devices: God as the consuming fire who fights for them.

scenes.scene_name: Not for Your Righteousness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not say in your heart.' Ends 'you are a stiff-necked people.' Devices: Conquest by grace and the nations' wickedness, not Israel's merit.

scenes.scene_name: Remember Horeb: the Golden Calf
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'remember and do not forget.' Ends 'they have made an idol.' Devices: The forty days on the mountain; rebellion at the foot.

scenes.scene_name: Moses Breaks the Tablets
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the LORD's offer to destroy them. Ends with the shattered tablets. Devices: The broken tablets dramatize the broken covenant.

scenes.scene_name: Forty Days of Intercession; the Calf Destroyed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses falling before the LORD. Ends grinding the calf to dust. Devices: Renewed forty-day fast; the idol pulverized.

scenes.scene_name: Rebellions Recalled: From the First Day
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts naming Taberah, Massah, Kibroth-hattaavah. Ends 'you have been rebellious.' Devices: A catalogue of rebellions—the pattern exposed.

scenes.scene_name: Moses' Prayer: Remember Abraham
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the prayer in the forty days. Ends 'your people, your inheritance.' Devices: Appeal to the patriarchs and to God's reputation.

scenes.scene_name: The Second Tablets; the Ark
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'at that time the LORD said.' Ends with the tablets in the ark. Devices: Covenant renewed; the law preserved.

scenes.scene_name: Aaron's Death; Levi Set Apart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the itinerary note. Ends 'the LORD is his inheritance.' Devices: Embedded history; the Levites' special portion.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Relents; 'Continue the Journey'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'I stayed on the mountain.' Ends 'lead the people.' Devices: Intercession accepted; the march resumes.

scenes.scene_name: What Does the LORD Require? Fear and Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'and now, what does the LORD ask?' Ends 'he chose you.' Devices: The famous summary—fear, walk, love, serve.

scenes.scene_name: Circumcise Your Hearts; Love the Foreigner
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'circumcise your hearts.' Ends 'love the foreigner.' Devices: Inward religion; God's impartial justice as the model.

scenes.scene_name: Cling to Him; Seventy Became as the Stars
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'fear the LORD, hold fast to him.' Ends 'as numerous as the stars.' Devices: The Abrahamic promise fulfilled.

scenes.scene_name: Know His Discipline: What He Did to Egypt
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'love the LORD and keep his charge.' Ends drowning Pharaoh's army. Devices: The adults who 'saw with their own eyes' are addressed.

scenes.scene_name: What He Did in the Wilderness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts recalling the wilderness. Ends 'your own eyes have seen.' Devices: Dathan and Abiram swallowed—discipline witnessed firsthand.

scenes.scene_name: A Land the LORD Cares For
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'observe therefore.' Ends 'his eyes are continually on it.' Devices: Canaan contrasted with Egypt—a land watered by heaven.

scenes.scene_name: Rain in Its Season—If You Obey
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you faithfully obey.' Ends 'the land will yield no produce.' Devices: The early and latter rains tied to covenant fidelity.

scenes.scene_name: Bind These Words; Teach Your Children
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'fix these words in your hearts.' Ends 'as many as the days the heavens are above the earth.' Devices: The Shema's pedagogy restated.

scenes.scene_name: Every Place Your Foot Treads
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you carefully keep.' Ends 'no one will be able to stand against you.' Devices: Sweeping land-promise; dread upon the nations.

scenes.scene_name: A Blessing and a Curse Set Before You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'see, I set before you a blessing and a curse.' Ends the conditional. Devices: The fundamental choice—blessing for obedience, curse for apostasy.

scenes.scene_name: On Gerizim and Ebal
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the command for the ceremony. Ends 'be careful to obey.' Devices: The two mountains anticipate chapter 27's covenant ritual.

stories.story_title: The Second Address, Part 2: The Deuteronomic Code
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: The statutes and ordinances themselves—worship, leadership, justice, warfare, family, and society—framed by the central-sanctuary law (12) and the firstfruits creed and covenant summary (26).

scenes.scene_name: Destroy the Pagan Places of Worship
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the code with the demolition command. Ends 'you must not worship the LORD in their way.' Devices: Negative prologue—clear the land of idolatry.

scenes.scene_name: Seek the Place the LORD Will Choose
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'seek the place.' Ends 'rejoice in everything you have put your hand to.' Devices: Cult centralization; joy in worship.

scenes.scene_name: Rejoice There Once You Have Rest
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'not as we do here.' Ends 'rejoice...with the Levite.' Devices: Future-oriented worship; inclusion of the landless Levite.

scenes.scene_name: Sacrifice Only Where He Chooses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'be careful not to sacrifice anywhere.' Ends 'pour the blood on the ground.' Devices: Place-restriction; blood prohibition.

scenes.scene_name: Tithes at the Place; Do Not Neglect the Levite
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the list of holy gifts. Ends 'do not neglect the Levite.' Devices: Sacred meals at the sanctuary; care for the Levite.

scenes.scene_name: Eating Meat in Your Towns; Pour Out the Blood
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when the LORD enlarges your territory.' Ends 'so that it may go well with you.' Devices: Secular slaughter permitted; blood still sacred.

scenes.scene_name: Bring Your Holy Things to the Place
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'take your consecrated things.' Ends doing 'what is good and right.' Devices: The sacred reserved for the chosen place.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Inquire After Their Gods
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the warning after conquest. Ends 'do not add to it or take from it.' Devices: The snare of curiosity about pagan worship; the canon principle.

scenes.scene_name: The Prophet Who Leads to Other Gods
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the false prophet's sign. Ends 'purge the evil.' Devices: Even a true sign cannot justify apostasy—the LORD is testing you.

scenes.scene_name: If a Loved One Entices You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the secret enticer. Ends 'all Israel will hear and be afraid.' Devices: Loyalty to God above family; deterrence by public justice.

scenes.scene_name: A City Led Astray
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the rumor of an apostate town. Ends putting it to the sword. Devices: Investigation before judgment; corporate apostasy.

scenes.scene_name: The City Burned as a Whole Offering
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts gathering the plunder. Ends 'the LORD will show you mercy.' Devices: The city as a herem offering; obedience restores favor.

scenes.scene_name: You Are Holy: No Pagan Mourning, No Detestable Food
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you are children of the LORD.' Ends 'do not eat any detestable thing.' Devices: Holiness shapes mourning and diet.

scenes.scene_name: Clean and Unclean Land Animals
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the list of edible animals. Ends 'they are unclean for you.' Devices: The dietary boundaries (cf. Lev 11).

scenes.scene_name: Creatures of the Water
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts fins-and-scales rule. Ends 'it is unclean for you.' Devices: Brief aquatic criterion.

scenes.scene_name: Clean Birds; Forbidden Birds
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you may eat any clean bird.' Ends the first forbidden birds. Devices: Predators and carrion-eaters excluded.

scenes.scene_name: Forbidden Birds and Winged Creatures
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with the raven. Ends with the bat. Devices: Completing the avian list.

scenes.scene_name: Insects, Carcasses, and the Kid in Milk
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts winged insects. Ends 'do not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.' Devices: Holiness even toward the foreigner and the resident alien.

scenes.scene_name: The Yearly Tithe Eaten Before the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'set aside a tenth.' Ends 'do not neglect the Levite.' Devices: A feast of gratitude; provision for travel to the place.

scenes.scene_name: The Third-Year Tithe for the Levite and Poor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'at the end of every three years.' Ends 'so that the LORD may bless you.' Devices: The welfare tithe—Levite, foreigner, orphan, widow.

scenes.scene_name: The Year of Release: Cancel Debts
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'at the end of seven years.' Ends 'you will rule over many nations.' Devices: Sabbatical debt-cancellation; blessing tied to generosity.

scenes.scene_name: Open Your Hand to the Poor
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if there is a poor man.' Ends 'be openhanded.' Devices: 'There will always be poor'—a perpetual command to give.

scenes.scene_name: Release the Servant in the Seventh Year
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the manumission law. Ends 'remember you were slaves.' Devices: Generous release; the exodus as motive.

scenes.scene_name: The Servant Who Stays for Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if your servant says, I do not want to leave.' Ends 'the LORD will bless you.' Devices: The awl through the ear—voluntary lifelong service.

scenes.scene_name: The Firstborn Males Consecrated
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'set apart every firstborn male.' Ends pouring out the blood. Devices: Firstlings to the LORD; no blemished animal.

scenes.scene_name: Keep the Passover at the Chosen Place
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the Passover command. Ends with no leaven for seven days. Devices: Centralized Passover; 'the bread of affliction.'

scenes.scene_name: Seven Days of Unleavened Bread
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the place-restriction for Passover. Ends 'do no work.' Devices: National pilgrimage feast at the sanctuary.

scenes.scene_name: The Feast of Weeks
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts counting seven weeks. Ends 'remember you were slaves.' Devices: A freewill feast of joy, inclusive of the vulnerable.

scenes.scene_name: The Feast of Booths; Three Times a Year
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the autumn feast. Ends 'no one should appear empty-handed.' Devices: The three pilgrim feasts summarized; give as you are blessed.

scenes.scene_name: Appoint Judges; Pursue Justice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'appoint judges and officials.' Ends 'justice, justice you shall pursue.' Devices: No bribes, no partiality—the famous double imperative.

scenes.scene_name: No Asherah Poles or Sacred Stones
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the ban on Asherah beside the altar. Ends 'the LORD hates them.' Devices: Purity of worship guarded at the sanctuary.

scenes.scene_name: No Blemished Sacrifice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A single-verse rule: offer nothing defective. Devices: Wholeness as honor to God; bridges into the judicial laws.

scenes.scene_name: The Worshiper of Other Gods: Two or Three Witnesses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the apostasy case. Ends 'purge the evil.' Devices: Evidentiary standard; the witnesses' hands first in execution.

scenes.scene_name: Hard Cases Brought to the Priests and Judge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if cases are too difficult.' Ends deterrence 'so no one will act presumptuously.' Devices: A central court of appeal; submission to the verdict.

scenes.scene_name: A King the LORD Chooses; His Limits
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you say, let us set a king.' Ends the bans on horses, wives, and gold. Devices: Kingship hedged against pride and apostasy.

scenes.scene_name: The King Must Copy and Read the Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when he takes the throne.' Ends 'so that he and his descendants may reign long.' Devices: A king under the Torah—the king as chief reader.

scenes.scene_name: The Levites' Portion: the LORD Is Their Inheritance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'the Levitical priests shall have no allotment.' Ends 'the LORD chose them.' Devices: Priestly dues; God as their inheritance.

scenes.scene_name: The Levite Who Comes to the Chosen Place
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the Levite's right to serve. Ends 'equal benefits.' Devices: Provision for the migrating Levite.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Imitate Pagan Divination
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not imitate the detestable ways.' Ends 'the LORD has not permitted you to do so.' Devices: A catalogue of occult practices forbidden.

scenes.scene_name: A Prophet Like Moses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'the LORD will raise up a prophet like me.' Ends 'I will hold him accountable.' Devices: The prophetic-succession promise (read messianically).

scenes.scene_name: Testing a True Prophet
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the presumptuous prophet. Ends 'do not be afraid of him.' Devices: Fulfillment as the test of a true word.

scenes.scene_name: Set Apart Cities of Refuge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when the LORD has destroyed the nations.' Ends building roads to them. Devices: Mercy structured into the land.

scenes.scene_name: The Accidental Killer Protected
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the case of unintentional killing. Ends 'set apart three cities.' Devices: The avenger restrained by law.

scenes.scene_name: Three More Cities if the Land Expands
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if the LORD enlarges your territory.' Ends 'so innocent blood will not be shed.' Devices: Provision scaled to the promise.

scenes.scene_name: But Not for the Murderer
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if a man hates his neighbor.' Ends 'purge the guilt of innocent blood.' Devices: Refuge withheld from the willful killer.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Move a Boundary Stone
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A single-verse property law. Devices: Protecting the inheritance handed down by the ancestors.

scenes.scene_name: The Malicious Witness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'one witness is not enough.' Ends investigation of the false witness. Devices: Due process; the two-or-three-witness rule.

scenes.scene_name: Life for Life, Eye for Eye
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do to him as he intended.' Ends the talion formula. Devices: Proportional, deterrent justice.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Fear: the LORD Goes With You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the war law. Ends 'he will give you victory.' Devices: The priest's battlefield exhortation against fear.

scenes.scene_name: Exemptions from Battle
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the officers' proclamation. Ends appointing commanders. Devices: New house, vineyard, betrothal, and fear excuse a man.

scenes.scene_name: Terms of Peace for Distant Cities
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you march to attack a city.' Ends taking the plunder. Devices: Offer of peace before siege; mercy bounded.

scenes.scene_name: Devote the Nearby Nations to Destruction
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the herem on the Canaanite cities. Ends 'or they will teach you their detestable ways.' Devices: Total devotion to prevent idolatry.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Destroy the Fruit Trees
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you besiege a city.' Ends using only non-fruit trees. Devices: 'Are the trees men?'—restraint even in war.

scenes.scene_name: The Heifer and the Elders
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the unsolved-murder rite. Ends the priests' role. Devices: Corporate responsibility for innocent blood.

scenes.scene_name: Cleanse the Guilt of Innocent Blood
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the elders washing their hands. Ends 'you will purge the guilt.' Devices: Ritual disavowal; the land cleansed.

scenes.scene_name: Marrying a Captive Woman
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the captive-bride law. Ends 'you must not sell her.' Devices: Dignity and protection for the vulnerable captive.

scenes.scene_name: The Firstborn's Double Portion
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the two-wives case. Ends 'the right of the firstborn.' Devices: Justice over favoritism in inheritance.

scenes.scene_name: The Rebellious Son
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the stubborn son brought to the elders. Ends 'all Israel will hear and be afraid.' Devices: Family authority under communal justice.

scenes.scene_name: A Body Hung on a Tree—Cursed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the executed criminal. Ends 'anyone hung is under God's curse.' Devices: Bury the same day; the land kept undefiled (cf. Gal 3:13).

scenes.scene_name: Return Your Brother's Lost Property
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not ignore your brother's ox.' Ends helping lift the fallen donkey. Devices: Active love of neighbor in daily life.

scenes.scene_name: Mixed Things, the Nest, and the Parapet
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts cross-dressing prohibition. Ends the roof railing. Devices: Order, mercy to the mother bird, and safety—holiness in ordinary life.

scenes.scene_name: No Mixing Seed, Cloth, or Team; Tassels
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts forbidden mixtures. Ends the tassels. Devices: Symbolic distinctness; visible reminders of the covenant.

scenes.scene_name: The Husband's False Charge
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the slander of a bride. Ends the parents' defense. Devices: Protecting a woman's honor; evidence required.

scenes.scene_name: The Proof of Virginity; the Fine
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the cloth as evidence. Ends 'he cannot divorce her.' Devices: Vindication and penalty for slander.

scenes.scene_name: When the Charge Is True
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the case proven. Ends 'purge the evil.' Devices: The grave view of covenant infidelity.

scenes.scene_name: Adultery and Betrothed Women
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts adultery. Ends the city case. Devices: Distinctions of guilt by circumstance.

scenes.scene_name: The Woman in the Field Is Innocent
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the assault in the country. Ends 'there was no one to rescue her.' Devices: Mercy—the cry unheard does not condemn the victim.

scenes.scene_name: Seduction and a Father's Wife
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the unbetrothed virgin. Ends 'a man shall not dishonor his father's bed.' Devices: Restitution by marriage; family honor protected.

scenes.scene_name: Who May Enter the Assembly
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts exclusions from the assembly. Ends the ban on Ammon and Moab. Devices: Boundaries of the worshiping community; history remembered.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Despise Edom or Egypt
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not despise an Edomite.' Ends the third-generation entry. Devices: Kinship and hospitality tempering exclusion.

scenes.scene_name: Keep the Camp Holy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the war-camp purity laws. Ends 'he must not see anything indecent.' Devices: 'The LORD walks in your camp'—holiness in the mundane.

scenes.scene_name: The Escaped Slave; No Cult Prostitution
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts protection of the runaway slave. Ends 'the LORD detests them both.' Devices: Compassion and cultic purity together.

scenes.scene_name: No Interest from a Brother
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the interest law. Ends 'so the LORD may bless you.' Devices: Brotherly economics distinguished from dealings with foreigners.

scenes.scene_name: Vows Must Be Kept
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you make a vow.' Ends 'you must do what you have promised.' Devices: The binding word; freedom not to vow, duty to fulfill.

scenes.scene_name: Eating from a Neighbor's Field
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the grapes and grain. Ends 'do not put a sickle to it.' Devices: Generosity without exploitation.

scenes.scene_name: The Law of Divorce and Remarriage
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the certificate of divorce. Ends 'that would be detestable.' Devices: Limiting remarriage to a former wife; protecting the land.

scenes.scene_name: A New Husband Exempt; the Pledge; Kidnapping
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the one-year exemption. Ends the kidnapper's death. Devices: Compassion for newlyweds; the millstone not taken in pledge.

scenes.scene_name: Guard Against Skin Disease; Remember Miriam
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the leprosy instruction. Ends 'remember what the LORD did to Miriam.' Devices: History as warning embedded in law.

scenes.scene_name: Return the Poor Man's Pledged Cloak
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not go into his house to get the pledge.' Ends 'it will be credited to you as righteousness.' Devices: Dignity of the debtor; mercy by sundown.

scenes.scene_name: Pay the Hired Worker the Same Day
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not take advantage of the poor.' Ends 'he may cry to the LORD against you.' Devices: Wages owed daily; God hears the worker.

scenes.scene_name: Each Dies for His Own Sin
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A single-verse principle of individual responsibility. Devices: Fathers and sons not put to death for each other.

scenes.scene_name: Justice for the Foreigner, Orphan, Widow
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not deprive the foreigner of justice.' Ends 'remember you were slaves.' Devices: The exodus as the ground of compassion.

scenes.scene_name: Leave the Gleanings for the Needy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the forgotten sheaf. Ends 'remember you were slaves in Egypt.' Devices: Structured generosity—the harvest shared.

scenes.scene_name: Limited Flogging Preserves Dignity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the courtroom flogging. Ends 'your brother will be degraded.' Devices: Punishment capped to protect human dignity.

scenes.scene_name: Do Not Muzzle the Ox
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A single-verse mercy law. Devices: The worker shares in the fruit of labor (cf. 1 Cor 9).

scenes.scene_name: Levirate Marriage; the Removed Sandal
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the brother-in-law duty. Ends 'the family of the unsandaled.' Devices: Preserving a dead brother's name; public shaming for refusal.

scenes.scene_name: An Immodest Intervention Punished
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the brawl. Ends the penalty. Devices: A narrow case guarding propriety.

scenes.scene_name: Honest Weights and Measures
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'do not have two differing weights.' Ends 'the LORD detests dishonest dealing.' Devices: Integrity in commerce as covenant faithfulness.

scenes.scene_name: Blot Out the Memory of Amalek
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'remember what Amalek did.' Ends 'do not forget.' Devices: A standing command of justice against the cowardly attacker.

scenes.scene_name: Bring the Firstfruits in a Basket
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when you enter the land.' Ends the priest setting the basket down. Devices: Liturgy of gratitude opens the code's conclusion.

scenes.scene_name: The Creed: 'My Father Was a Wandering Aramean'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the recited confession. Ends 'a land flowing with milk and honey.' Devices: Israel's salvation-history creed.

scenes.scene_name: Set It Before the LORD and Rejoice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts presenting the firstfruits. Ends rejoicing with the Levite and foreigner. Devices: Worship culminating in shared joy.

scenes.scene_name: The Third-Year Tithe Declaration
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the tithe for the needy. Ends 'look down from heaven and bless.' Devices: A sworn declaration of obedience; intercession for the land.

scenes.scene_name: You Are His Treasured People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'this day the LORD commands you.' Ends 'a people holy to the LORD.' Devices: Mutual covenant declaration—the code's grand seal.

stories.story_title: The Third Address: The Covenant Sanctions
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: The covenant ceremony and its consequences: the Ebal altar and curses (27), the blessings and the long catalogue of curses (28), the covenant renewed in Moab (29), and the final call to choose life (30).

scenes.scene_name: Write the Law on Plastered Stones
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the command to inscribe the law. Ends setting the stones on Mount Ebal. Devices: The law made monumental at the entry to the land.

scenes.scene_name: Build an Altar of Uncut Stones
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the altar command. Ends 'write very clearly on them all the words.' Devices: Worship and law together at the covenant site.

scenes.scene_name: This Day You Have Become His People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'be silent and listen.' Ends 'obey the LORD.' Devices: A solemn covenant-making declaration.

scenes.scene_name: The Tribes on Gerizim and Ebal
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts assigning the tribes to the mountains. Ends the blessing and cursing tribes. Devices: The dramatic antiphonal ceremony staged.

scenes.scene_name: Curses: Idolatry, Dishonor, Injustice
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the Levites' proclamation. Ends cursing those who pervert justice. Devices: The dodecalogue of curses, each sealed with 'Amen.'

scenes.scene_name: Curses on Forbidden Unions
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the curse on incest. Ends the mother-in-law. Devices: Hidden sins exposed under the covenant oath.

scenes.scene_name: Curses on Secret Violence and All Who Disobey
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts secret killing and bribery. Ends 'cursed is anyone who does not uphold this law.' Devices: The summary curse on disobedience (cf. Gal 3:10).

scenes.scene_name: Blessings That Overtake the Obedient
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you fully obey.' Ends 'blessed coming in and going out.' Devices: Blessings that 'come upon and overtake you'—comprehensive favor.

scenes.scene_name: Victory, Plenty, and a Holy People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts enemies defeated. Ends 'the peoples will fear you.' Devices: Security and reputation among the nations.

scenes.scene_name: Abundance; the Head and Not the Tail
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts overflowing prosperity. Ends 'do not turn aside.' Devices: Supremacy promised, conditioned on fidelity.

scenes.scene_name: Curses That Overtake the Disobedient
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you do not obey.' Ends 'cursed going out.' Devices: The mirror image of the blessings—curses overtake.

scenes.scene_name: Disease, Drought, and Defeat
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts confusion and rebuke. Ends 'until you are destroyed.' Devices: Escalating natural and martial disasters.

scenes.scene_name: Routed, Plagued, and Groping at Noon
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts defeat before enemies. Ends 'groping at midday like a blind man.' Devices: Helplessness and madness as judgment.

scenes.scene_name: Stolen Labor and Lost Harvest
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the betrothed taken, the house unused. Ends a foreign people consuming your produce. Devices: Futility curses—labor without enjoyment.

scenes.scene_name: Madness and a Proverb Among the Nations
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts driven mad by what you see. Ends 'an object of scorn.' Devices: The covenant people made a byword.

scenes.scene_name: Locusts and Worms Consume All
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts seed devoured. Ends locusts taking the trees. Devices: Agricultural ruin in vivid detail.

scenes.scene_name: The Foreigner Rises, You Sink
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the alien ascending. Ends 'a sign and a wonder forever.' Devices: Reversal of fortunes as lasting testimony.

scenes.scene_name: A Nation from Afar with an Iron Yoke
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'because you did not serve joyfully.' Ends devouring your livestock and crops. Devices: The eagle-swift invader; the iron yoke.

scenes.scene_name: Siege So Terrible You Eat Your Own Children
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the besieged cities. Ends the horror of cannibalism. Devices: The unthinkable depths of the siege curse.

scenes.scene_name: Fearful Plagues and Reversal of Fortune
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'if you do not carefully obey.' Ends 'uprooted from the land.' Devices: 'As the LORD delighted to bless, so he will delight to ruin.'

scenes.scene_name: Scattered Among the Nations; Back to Egypt
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts dispersion among all peoples. Ends 'no one will buy you' as slaves. Devices: Exile and a despairing return—the curse's nadir.

scenes.scene_name: A Covenant Beyond Horeb; Eyes Yet Unseeing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the Moab covenant. Ends 'the LORD has not given you a heart to understand.' Devices: A second covenant; spiritual blindness named.

scenes.scene_name: Remember the Wilderness; Keep This Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the forty years recalled. Ends 'so that you may prosper.' Devices: Provision remembered as motive for obedience.

scenes.scene_name: All of You Stand Today to Enter the Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'you are standing here.' Ends 'as he promised your fathers.' Devices: The whole nation, high and low, bound together.

scenes.scene_name: This Oath Binds Future Generations Too
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'I am making this covenant also with those not here.' Ends recalling the idols of the nations. Devices: A trans-generational oath.

scenes.scene_name: No Secret Idolater—'I Have Peace'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the bitter root. Ends the LORD blotting out his name. Devices: The hidden apostate exposed; complacency rebuked.

scenes.scene_name: Why Has the LORD Done This?
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts future generations seeing the ruin. Ends the nations' question. Devices: The devastated land as a sermon to onlookers.

scenes.scene_name: Because They Forsook the Covenant
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the answer. Ends 'thrust them into another land.' Devices: Exile explained as covenant-breaking.

scenes.scene_name: The Secret Things Belong to the LORD
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: A single-verse maxim closing the chapter. Devices: Mystery and revelation balanced—'the revealed things belong to us.'

scenes.scene_name: Return and the LORD Will Gather You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'when all these things come upon you.' Ends 'he will gather you.' Devices: Restoration after exile—repentance opens the way home.

scenes.scene_name: He Will Circumcise Your Heart
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the promise of a circumcised heart. Ends 'with all your heart.' Devices: The answer to 5:29—God enables the love he commands.

scenes.scene_name: The Commandment Is Not Too Hard
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'this command is not too difficult.' Ends 'in your mouth and in your heart.' Devices: Nearness of the word (cf. Rom 10).

scenes.scene_name: The Choice of Life and Death
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'see, I set before you life and death.' Ends 'choose life.' Devices: The book's great summons; heaven and earth as witnesses.

stories.story_title: The Appendix: Song, Blessing, and Farewell
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Moses' final acts: commissioning Joshua and depositing the law (31), the Song of Moses as covenant witness (32), the tribal Blessing (33), and the death of Moses on Nebo (34).

scenes.scene_name: 'Be Strong and Courageous'; the LORD Goes With You
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses at 120 years. Ends 'he will never leave you.' Devices: The leader's farewell; the refrain that Joshua will inherit.

scenes.scene_name: Moses Charges Joshua Before All Israel
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses summoning Joshua. Ends 'do not be afraid.' Devices: Public succession; the LORD goes before.

scenes.scene_name: The Deposition of the Law
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses writing the law and giving it to the priests. Ends teaching the children. Devices: Septennial public reading at Booths—covenant renewal built in.

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Foretells Israel's Apostasy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the summons to the tent. Ends 'I will hide my face.' Devices: The grim prophecy that frames the Song.

scenes.scene_name: Write This Song as a Witness; Joshua Commissioned
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'write down this song.' Ends Joshua charged by the LORD. Devices: The Song as legal witness against future Israel.

scenes.scene_name: The Book Placed Beside the Ark as a Witness
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses finishing the writing. Ends 'how much more after my death.' Devices: The law as a standing witness; Israel's stubbornness named.

scenes.scene_name: Moses Speaks the Song in Their Hearing
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts gathering the elders. Ends Moses reciting the Song. Devices: Heaven and earth summoned as witnesses—transition to the poem.

scenes.scene_name: The Song: 'Give Ear, O Heavens'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the cosmic summons. Ends 'is he not your Father?' Devices: Doctrine like rain; the Rock whose works are perfect.

scenes.scene_name: He Kept Him Like the Apple of His Eye
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'remember the days of old.' Ends 'the LORD alone led him.' Devices: The eagle stirring its nest—tender election imagery.

scenes.scene_name: Jeshurun Grew Fat and Forsook God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts feeding him the produce of the land. Ends 'you forgot the God who gave you birth.' Devices: Prosperity breeding apostasy—the Song's turn.

scenes.scene_name: Provoked to Jealousy by 'No-Gods'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the LORD's rejection. Ends fire burning to the depths. Devices: Lex talionis of jealousy—'I will make them jealous by a non-people.'

scenes.scene_name: Famine, Pestilence, the Sword
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts heaping disasters. Ends terror within and without. Devices: Comprehensive judgment in poetic compression.

scenes.scene_name: Yet Not Utterly Destroyed—Lest the Enemy Boast
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'I would have scattered them.' Ends 'their rock is not like our Rock.' Devices: Restraint for the sake of God's name; the enemy's folly.

scenes.scene_name: Vengeance Is Mine; the Day of Calamity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the bitter vine of the enemy. Ends 'their foot will slip.' Devices: Judgment stored up (cf. Rom 12:19).

scenes.scene_name: The LORD Will Vindicate His People
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'the LORD will judge his people.' Ends mocking the impotent idols. Devices: Compassion follows judgment; the gods who cannot save.

scenes.scene_name: 'See Now That I Am He'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the great self-declaration. Ends 'rejoice, O nations, with his people.' Devices: 'I put to death and I bring to life'; cosmic vindication.

scenes.scene_name: Narrative Conclusion to the Song
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses reciting it with Joshua. Ends 'they are your life.' Devices: The Song applied—'not idle words.'

scenes.scene_name: God's Command for Moses to Ascend Nebo
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'that same day.' Ends 'you will not enter.' Devices: The death sentence reaffirmed; Meribah recalled—prepares chapter 34.

scenes.scene_name: The Blessing Introduction: God's Majesty
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'this is the blessing.' Ends 'the LORD was king over Jeshurun.' Devices: A theophany prologue framing the tribal blessings.

scenes.scene_name: Reuben and Judah Blessed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'let Reuben live.' Ends the plea for Judah. Devices: Survival and restoration sought for the firstborn and the royal tribe.

scenes.scene_name: Levi: Thummim and Urim, the Teaching Tribe
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the blessing of Levi. Ends 'strike down those who rise against him.' Devices: Levi's zeal at Massah rewarded with priestly office.

scenes.scene_name: Benjamin and Joseph Blessed
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'the beloved of the LORD.' Ends the ten thousands of Ephraim. Devices: Benjamin sheltered; Joseph's lavish, fertile blessing.

scenes.scene_name: Zebulun, Issachar, and Gad
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'rejoice, Zebulun.' Ends Gad executing the LORD's justice. Devices: Sea-trade, tents, and the lion of Gad.

scenes.scene_name: Dan, Naphtali, and Asher
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'Dan is a lion's cub.' Ends 'your strength will equal your days.' Devices: Brief, vivid tribal images closing the roll.

scenes.scene_name: 'There Is None Like the God of Jeshurun'
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts the praise of God. Ends 'you will tread on their heights.' Devices: 'The eternal God is your refuge'—the blessing's triumphant close.

scenes.scene_name: The Vision from Nebo
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Moses ascending Pisgah. Ends 'I have let you see it, but you will not cross.' Devices: The whole land shown—promise seen, not entered.

scenes.scene_name: The Death and Burial of Moses
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts 'Moses died there.' Ends thirty days of mourning. Devices: Buried by the LORD himself; his eye undimmed at 120.

scenes.scene_name: Joshua's Succession and Moses's Eulogy
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts Joshua filled with the spirit of wisdom. Ends 'no prophet has risen like Moses.' Devices: The Pentateuch's closing eulogy—unmatched intimacy with God.
